data.originalText: A dramatic anime-style cyberpunk witch standing on a dark rooftop high above a dense futuristic city at night, viewed from a slightly elevated angle. The main subject is a petite young witch girl with pale skin, short icy blue bobbed hair, pointed elf-like ears, and glowing red eyes, wearing a sly confident smile. She raises a black wand overhead in her right hand, with a dangling orb charm at the tip glowing faintly purple and red. Her oversized crooked witch hat is black with purple lining and covered in stitched patches, warning labels, straps, and white graphics including a large “404” and a skull emblem. She wears a black and purple techwear outfit: oversized hooded jacket with many straps and tags, black crop top with “404” on the chest, layered belts, short bottoms, fishnet on one leg, black lace-up combat boots, chokers, and metallic accessories. Several hanging straps and tags visibly read words like “WITCH 404,” “404,” and glitch-themed markings. Beneath and beside her, a large glowing violet magic circle mixed with hacker interface aesthetics is projected on the rooftop floor, filled with occult rings, sigils, a central skull symbol, and scattered neon system text such as error-code fragments, creating a fusion of sorcery and digital corruption. Emerging from the circle is 1 large armored summoned figure: a black futuristic demon-knight or robotic familiar with jagged reflective armor, a narrow purple-lit visor, and a heavy weapon held in one hand, partially dissolving into purple energy shards and smoke. The background shows a sprawling rainy megacity of apartment towers and industrial rooftops, packed with windows, balconies, cables, signs, and haze. On a nearby building wall is a giant vertical graffiti-style sign with 3 readable elements: “404”, “Witch”, and “ERROR NOT FOUND”, plus a smaller “E404”. Additional purple neon glitch text and symbols are scattered across rooftops and in the air. Use a dark palette of black, indigo, and deep violet with sharp magenta-purple highlights, cinematic contrast, reflective wet surfaces, dense detail, and a high-end polished illustration style. The mood is occult, edgy, stylish, and dangerous, combining urban fantasy, hacker aesthetics, and magical summoning.

textTranslations.zh-CN: 一张极具戏剧性的动漫风格赛博朋克女巫插画，她站在深夜未来都市高处的阴暗屋顶上，视角略微俯视。主角是一位皮肤白皙、留着冰蓝色短波波头、长着精灵尖耳、眼神狡黠自信的年轻女巫。她右手高举一根黑色魔杖，杖尖悬挂的球形饰物散发着淡淡的紫红色光芒。她戴着一顶巨大的黑色尖顶女巫帽，内衬为紫色，上面布满了缝补的补丁、警告标签、带子以及白色图案，包括醒目的“404”字样和骷髅徽章。她身穿黑紫色科技感服装：带有许多带子和标签的超大连帽夹克、胸前印有“404”的黑色短款上衣、多层腰带、短裤、单腿渔网袜、黑色系带战斗靴、颈圈以及金属配饰。多条悬挂的带子和标签上清晰可见“WITCH 404”、“404”以及故障艺术风格的标记。在她身下及身侧，屋顶地面投射出一个巨大的紫色发光魔法阵，融合了黑客界面美学，阵中充满了神秘圆环、符文、中央骷髅标志以及散落的霓虹系统文本（如错误代码片段），营造出巫术与数字腐蚀交织的氛围。从魔法阵中浮现出一个巨大的装甲召唤物：一个黑色的未来派恶魔骑士或机器人使魔，身披锯齿状反光盔甲，戴着狭长的紫色发光面罩，单手持重型武器，身体部分正在消散为紫色的能量碎片与烟雾。背景展现了一座广阔的雨中大都市，高楼林立，屋顶工业感十足，布满了窗户、阳台、电缆、招牌和雾气。附近建筑的墙上有一个巨大的垂直涂鸦风格招牌，上面有 3 个清晰可见的元素：“404”、“Witch”和“ERROR NOT FOUND”，以及一个较小的“E404”。屋顶和空中散布着额外的紫色霓虹故障文字和符号。整体采用黑色、靛蓝和深紫色的暗色调，搭配鲜明的洋红色与紫色高光，具有电影级的对比度、反光的湿润表面、丰富的细节以及高端精致的插画风格。氛围神秘、前卫、时尚且危险，完美融合了都市奇幻、黑客美学与魔法召唤元素。
textTranslations.vi-VN: Một phù thủy cyberpunk phong cách anime đầy kịch tính đang đứng trên sân thượng tối tăm cao vút phía trên một thành phố tương lai đông đúc vào ban đêm, góc nhìn từ trên cao. Nhân vật chính là một cô phù thủy nhỏ nhắn với làn da nhợt nhạt, mái tóc bob ngắn màu xanh băng giá, đôi tai nhọn như yêu tinh và đôi mắt đỏ rực, nở nụ cười tự tin đầy tinh quái. Cô giơ cao cây đũa phép màu đen bằng tay phải, với một chiếc bùa hình cầu treo ở đầu đang phát ra ánh sáng tím và đỏ mờ ảo. Chiếc mũ phù thủy chóp nhọn quá khổ của cô có màu đen với lớp lót màu tím, được bao phủ bởi các miếng vá, nhãn cảnh báo, dây đai và các họa tiết màu trắng bao gồm số “404” lớn và biểu tượng đầu lâu. Cô mặc trang phục techwear màu đen và tím: áo khoác trùm đầu quá khổ với nhiều dây đai và thẻ bài, áo crop top đen có chữ “404” trên ngực, thắt lưng nhiều lớp, quần ngắn, tất lưới một bên chân, bốt chiến đấu buộc dây màu đen, vòng cổ choker và các phụ kiện kim loại. Nhiều dây đai và thẻ bài treo lủng lẳng có ghi các từ như “WITCH 404”, “404” và các ký hiệu theo chủ đề lỗi glitch. Bên dưới và bên cạnh cô, một vòng tròn ma thuật màu tím rực rỡ pha trộn với thẩm mỹ giao diện hacker được chiếu trên sàn sân thượng, chứa đầy các vòng tròn huyền bí, ấn triện, biểu tượng đầu lâu ở trung tâm và các văn bản hệ thống neon rải rác như các mảnh mã lỗi, tạo nên sự kết hợp giữa ma thuật và sự hỏng hóc kỹ thuật số. Bước ra từ vòng tròn là 1 nhân vật được triệu hồi mặc giáp lớn: một hiệp sĩ quỷ hoặc linh vật robot tương lai màu đen với bộ giáp phản quang lởm chởm, tấm che mặt hẹp phát sáng màu tím và một vũ khí hạng nặng cầm trên một tay, một phần tan biến thành các mảnh năng lượng tím và khói. Phông nền là một siêu đô thị đầy mưa với các tòa tháp chung cư và sân thượng công nghiệp, chật kín cửa sổ, ban công, dây cáp, biển hiệu và sương mù. Trên bức tường tòa nhà gần đó là một biển hiệu graffiti dọc khổng lồ với 3 yếu tố có thể đọc được: “404”, “Witch” và “ERROR NOT FOUND”, cùng với một chữ “E404” nhỏ hơn. Các văn bản và ký hiệu glitch neon màu tím bổ sung được rải rác khắp các sân thượng và trong không trung. Sử dụng bảng màu tối gồm đen, chàm và tím đậm với các điểm nhấn màu đỏ tươi-tím sắc nét, độ tương phản điện ảnh, bề mặt ướt phản chiếu, chi tiết dày đặc và phong cách minh họa bóng bẩy cao cấp. Tâm trạng mang tính huyền bí, sắc sảo, phong cách và nguy hiểm, kết hợp giữa giả tưởng đô thị, thẩm mỹ hacker và triệu hồi ma thuật.
textTranslations.es-ES: Una dramática bruja cyberpunk estilo anime de pie sobre una azotea oscura en lo alto de una densa ciudad futurista durante la noche, vista desde un ángulo ligeramente elevado. El sujeto principal es una joven bruja menuda de piel pálida, cabello corto estilo bob azul hielo, orejas puntiagudas como las de un elfo y ojos rojos brillantes, luciendo una sonrisa astuta y confiada. Levanta una varita negra sobre su cabeza con la mano derecha, con un amuleto de orbe colgante en la punta que brilla tenuemente en púrpura y rojo. Su sombrero de bruja grande y torcido es negro con forro púrpura y está cubierto de parches cosidos, etiquetas de advertencia, correas y gráficos blancos que incluyen un gran “404” y un emblema de calavera. Viste un atuendo techwear negro y púrpura: chaqueta con capucha extragrande con muchas correas y etiquetas, top corto negro con “404” en el pecho, cinturones superpuestos, pantalones cortos, medias de red en una pierna, botas de combate negras con cordones, gargantillas y accesorios metálicos. Varias correas y etiquetas colgantes muestran palabras como “WITCH 404”, “404” y marcas con temática de glitch. Debajo y a su lado, un gran círculo mágico violeta brillante mezclado con estética de interfaz de hacker se proyecta en el suelo de la azotea, lleno de anillos ocultos, sigilos, un símbolo de calavera central y texto de sistema de neón disperso como fragmentos de códigos de error, creando una fusión de hechicería y corrupción digital. Del círculo emerge una gran figura invocada y blindada: un demonio caballero futurista negro o familiar robótico con armadura reflectante dentada, una visera estrecha iluminada en púrpura y un arma pesada sostenida en una mano, disolviéndose parcialmente en fragmentos de energía púrpura y humo. El fondo muestra una extensa megaciudad lluviosa de torres de apartamentos y azoteas industriales, repleta de ventanas, balcones, cables, letreros y neblina. En la pared de un edificio cercano hay un letrero vertical gigante estilo grafiti con 3 elementos legibles: “404”, “Witch” y “ERROR NOT FOUND”, además de un “E404” más pequeño. Texto y símbolos de glitch de neón púrpura adicionales están dispersos por las azoteas y en el aire. Utiliza una paleta oscura de negro, índigo y violeta profundo con reflejos nítidos en magenta-púrpura, contraste cinematográfico, superficies húmedas reflectantes, detalles densos y un estilo de ilustración pulido de alta gama. El ambiente es oculto, vanguardista, elegante y peligroso, combinando fantasía urbana, estética hacker e invocación mágica.

textTranslations.de-DE: Eine dramatische Cyberpunk-Hexe im Anime-Stil, die auf einem dunklen Dach hoch über einer dichten, futuristischen Stadt bei Nacht steht, gesehen aus einer leicht erhöhten Perspektive. Das Hauptmotiv ist ein zierliches, junges Hexenmädchen mit blasser Haut, kurzem, eisblauem Bob, spitzen, elfenartigen Ohren und leuchtend roten Augen, das ein verschmitztes, selbstbewusstes Lächeln trägt. Sie hebt einen schwarzen Zauberstab mit der rechten Hand über den Kopf, an dessen Spitze ein baumelnder Kugelanhänger schwach violett und rot leuchtet. Ihr übergroßer, schiefer Hexenhut ist schwarz mit violettem Innenfutter und mit aufgenähten Patches, Warnschildern, Riemen und weißen Grafiken bedeckt, darunter eine große „404“ und ein Totenkopf-Emblem. Sie trägt ein schwarz-violettes Techwear-Outfit: eine übergroße Kapuzenjacke mit vielen Riemen und Anhängern, ein schwarzes bauchfreies Top mit „404“ auf der Brust, mehrlagige Gürtel, kurze Hose, Netzstrumpf an einem Bein, schwarze Schnür-Combat-Boots, Choker und metallische Accessoires. Mehrere hängende Riemen und Anhänger tragen deutlich lesbare Wörter wie „WITCH 404“, „404“ und Glitch-Markierungen. Unter und neben ihr ist ein großer, leuchtend violetter magischer Kreis, vermischt mit Hacker-Interface-Ästhetik, auf den Dachboden projiziert, gefüllt mit okkulten Ringen, Siegeln, einem zentralen Totenkopfsymbol und verstreutem Neon-Systemtext wie Fehlercode-Fragmenten, was eine Verschmelzung von Zauberei und digitaler Korruption erzeugt. Aus dem Kreis taucht eine große, gepanzerte beschworene Figur auf: ein schwarzer, futuristischer Dämonenritter oder robotischer Vertrauter mit gezackter, reflektierender Rüstung, einem schmalen, violett leuchtenden Visier und einer schweren Waffe in einer Hand, die teilweise in violette Energiesplitter und Rauch zerfällt. Der Hintergrund zeigt eine weitläufige, regnerische Megacity aus Wohntürmen und Industriedächern, vollgepackt mit Fenstern, Balkonen, Kabeln, Schildern und Dunst. An einer nahegelegenen Gebäudewand befindet sich ein riesiges vertikales Graffiti-Schild mit 3 lesbaren Elementen: „404“, „Witch“ und „ERROR NOT FOUND“ sowie ein kleineres „E404“. Zusätzlicher violetter Neon-Glitch-Text und Symbole sind über die Dächer und in der Luft verstreut. Verwenden Sie eine dunkle Palette aus Schwarz, Indigo und tiefem Violett mit scharfen magenta-violetten Highlights, filmischem Kontrast, reflektierenden nassen Oberflächen, dichten Details und einem hochwertigen, polierten Illustrationsstil. Die Stimmung ist okkult, ausgefallen, stylisch und gefährlich und kombiniert Urban Fantasy, Hacker-Ästhetik und magische Beschwörung.
textTranslations.fr-FR: Une sorcière cyberpunk spectaculaire style anime, debout sur un toit sombre surplombant une ville futuriste dense la nuit, vue sous un angle légèrement surélevé. Émergeant du cercle, une grande silhouette invoquée et blindée : un démon-chevalier futuriste noir ou un familier robotique avec une armure réfléchissante dentelée, une visière étroite éclairée en violet et une arme lourde tenue dans une main, se dissolvant partiellement en éclats d'énergie violette et en fumée. data.originalText: A cinematic anime movie poster for a fictional film titled {argument name="headline text" default="EL VIAJE DE LA LUNA DE PLATA"}, in polished modern Japanese animation style with a natural, less over-detailed look. Center a teenage anime girl from mid-thigh up, facing forward, with a short silver bob haircut, pale skin, a black choker, small black geometric earrings, a white tank top, and a dark navy oversized zip hoodie with two yellow stripes running down the sleeves. She has a backpack strap over one shoulder and both hands tucked casually into the hoodie pockets. Her face is obscured by a flat rectangular censor block in a muted beige tone, covering the entire face area. Place her in a dramatic twilight coastal city setting that blends travel, nostalgia, and fantasy: on the left, a lit train platform with a commuter train approaching, its destination sign showing Japanese characters; behind it, a glowing city skyline with a ferris wheel. In the distance and lower left, layered mountains and a winding illuminated valley road. On the right, a cliffside coast at sunset with the sea reflecting warm light, a crescent moon in the sky, several flying seabirds, and a curving highway descending along the hillside. Also on the right, include a wooden signpost with exactly 3 directional signs labeled "NUEVOS CAMINOS", "VIEJOS RECUERDOS", and "SIN LÍMITES". At the top center, add the Spanish tagline {argument name="tagline text" default="CADA DESTINO CAMBIA SU HISTORIA"} in elegant serif capitals. On the upper left, create an awards column in gold typography with laurel wreaths and exactly 4 award blocks: one text block reading "GANADORA DE MÚLTIPLES PREMIOS" with 5 gold stars beneath it, then three laurel award sections reading "MEJOR PELÍCULA ANIMADA / FESTIVAL INTERNACIONAL DE ANIMACIÓN / 2024", "PREMIO DEL PÚBLICO / FESTIVAL INTERNACIONAL DE CINE / 2024", and "MEJOR BANDA SONORA ORIGINAL / ACADEMIA DE CINE ANIMADO / 2024". Place the film title large across the lower center in luminous ornate serif lettering with a magical glow and sweeping flourishes, layered partly over the character. Beneath it, add the Spanish quote {argument name="quote" default="A veces, para encontrarte... tienes que perderte en el mundo."}. Below that, add "UNA PELÍCULA DE ESTUDIO LUMINARIA" in small caps. At the bottom, add the release line {argument name="release text" default="PRÓXIMAMENTE EN CINES"} in large gold serif capitals, plus tiny production logos and credits along the footer, including a small studio emblem on the left. Rich blue, violet, and warm sunset orange palette, glossy poster lighting, romantic adventure mood, balanced composition, highly polished theatrical key art, vertical one-sheet film poster.

textTranslations.zh-CN: 一张电影级动漫风格海报，用于虚构的奇幻剧情片，标题为 {argument name="headline text" default="EL VIAJE DE LA LUNA DE PLATA"}，采用高级院线海报的垂直构图。画面中央是一位年轻动漫女性的半身肖像，她正面向前，神情平静而内敛。她留着短款银色波波头，发丝层次柔和且带有侧刘海，皮肤白皙，佩戴黑色颈圈和几何形状耳环，身穿宽松的海军蓝运动外套，袖口饰有双条金线，内搭白色吊带背心，单肩背着深色背包。她的表情细腻自然，去除了夸张的细节，呈现出更具写实感的绘画质感。在她身后，将多处旅行目的地风景融合成一幅无缝的魔法构图：左侧是黄昏时分灯火通明的火车站台，列车进站，远处是闪烁的城市天际线；下方是远山与蜿蜒的河谷；右侧是海岸落日，夕阳低垂于海面之上，伴有悬崖、新月和天空中飞翔的 2 只海鸟；右下角是一条蜿蜒的道路，穿过灯火通明的山丘，通向一座闪烁着灯光的城镇。在右侧添加一个木制路标，上面有 3 个指示牌，分别写着 "NUEVOS CAMINOS"、"VIEJOS RECUERDOS" 和 "SIN LÍMITES"。在顶部中央，添加标语 {argument name="tagline" default="CADA DESTINO CAMBIA SU HISTORIA"}，使用优雅的衬线大写字体。在左上方，放置 4 个带有月桂花环的金色奖项区域：1 行五星标志，文字为 "GANADORA DE MÚLTIPLES PREMIOS"，1 个奖项写着 "MEJOR PELÍCULA ANIMADA" 及下方较小的电影节文字，1 个奖项写着 "PREMIO DEL PÚBLICO" 及下方较小的电影节文字，以及 1 个奖项写着 "MEJOR BANDA SONORA ORIGINAL" 及下方较小的学院奖文字。在底部中央，放置巨大的发光衬线电影标题，采用华丽的夜光排版，叠加在角色的躯干上。在标题下方，添加简短的引语 {argument name="quote" default="A veces, para encontrarte... tienes que perderte en el mundo."}。在最底部，包含一行制片厂演职员表和上映信息 {argument name="release text" default="PRÓXIMAMENTE EN CINES"}（使用大号衬线大写字体），并在底部边缘添加微小的制作公司 Logo。使用浓郁的暮色蓝、金色夕阳余晖、柔和的洋红色云彩、大气雾气、反射高光、细腻的电影级布光，打造出一种情感丰富、充满冒险感且自然而不杂乱的精致插画海报风格。

textTranslations.es-ES: Un póster de película cinematográfico al estilo anime para un drama de fantasía ficticio titulado {argument name="headline text" default="EL VIAJE DE LA LUNA DE PLATA"}, con composición vertical como un póster de cine de alta calidad. En el centro, un retrato de medio cuerpo de una joven anime mirando al frente con una presencia tranquila e introspectiva. Tiene un corte de cabello bob corto de color plateado con capas suaves y flequillo lateral, piel pálida, una gargantilla negra, un pendiente geométrico negro, una chaqueta deportiva azul marino holgada con doble raya dorada en las mangas, una camiseta blanca debajo y la correa de una mochila oscura sobre un hombro. Su expresión es sutil y natural, con detalles menos exagerados y un acabado pictórico más realista. Detrás de ella, combina múltiples paisajes de destinos de viaje en una composición mágica y fluida: a la izquierda, un andén de tren iluminado al atardecer con un tren llegando y el horizonte de una ciudad brillante al fondo; debajo, montañas lejanas y un valle con un río serpenteante; a la derecha, una puesta de sol costera con el sol bajo sobre el océano, acantilados, una luna creciente y 2 aves marinas volando en el cielo; en la parte inferior derecha, una carretera curva que desciende a través de colinas iluminadas hacia un pueblo de luces brillantes. Añade un poste de madera a la derecha con exactamente 3 señales direccionales que digan "NUEVOS CAMINOS", "VIEJOS RECUERDOS" y "SIN LÍMITES". En la parte superior central, añade el eslogan {argument name="tagline" default="CADA DESTINO CAMBIA SU HISTORIA"} en elegantes mayúsculas con serifa. En la parte superior izquierda, coloca exactamente 4 secciones de premios dorados con laureles: 1 línea de cinco estrellas con el texto "GANADORA DE MÚLTIPLES PREMIOS", 1 premio que diga "MEJOR PELÍCULA ANIMADA" con texto de festival más pequeño debajo, 1 premio que diga "PREMIO DEL PÚBLICO" con texto de festival más pequeño debajo y 1 premio que diga "MEJOR BANDA SONORA ORIGINAL" con texto de academia más pequeño debajo. En la parte inferior central, coloca el título de la película en grande con una tipografía serifa luminosa y ornamentada, superpuesta sobre el torso del personaje. Debajo, añade la pequeña cita {argument name="quote" default="A veces, para encontrarte... tienes que perderte en el mundo."}. En la parte inferior, incluye una línea de crédito del estudio y el texto de estreno {argument name="release text" default="PRÓXIMAMENTE EN CINES"} en grandes mayúsculas con serifa, además de pequeños logotipos de producción a lo largo del borde inferior. Utiliza azules crepusculares intensos, luz dorada de atardecer, nubes magenta suaves, neblina atmosférica, reflejos brillantes, iluminación cinematográfica detallada y un aspecto de póster ilustrado pulido que se sienta emotivo, aventurero y natural en lugar de excesivamente recargado.

data.originalText: A dark fantasy gothic poster in a vertical composition, painted in a highly detailed anime-inspired style with dramatic lighting and rich texture. At the center is a beautiful young woman with long straight {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white"} hair, pale skin, and an elegant, calm but dangerous presence. Her face is mostly obscured in shadow and mystery. She wears an ornate black-and-deep-blue crystalline dress with lace, feathered and jagged organic details, semi-transparent flowing sleeves, and glowing blue highlights across the bodice and collar, as if infused with magic. Her right hand is raised slightly with an open gesture, while her left hand rests lower near her waist. Surrounding and partly growing from her are luminous blue butterflies and shard-like petals, creating a sense of transformation and corruption. Behind her looms a gigantic monstrous entity made of darkness, ink, smoke, and cosmic texture, with exactly 7 glowing blue eyes visible and a huge fanged grin packed with sharp icy-blue teeth. The creature feels Lovecraftian, predatory, and intimate, curling around her like a guardian, curse, or inner demon. The palette is dominated by black, midnight navy, indigo, and electric blue, with sparkling highlights like stars or wet paint splatter. Add a decorative antique silver filigree border in all 4 corners and along the edges, making it feel like a sinister book cover or exhibition poster. Place large Japanese title text at the top: {argument name="title text" default="私の中のバケモノ"}. Add 8 blocks of vertical Japanese copy around the figure, 4 on the left and 4 on the right, in elegant white Mincho-style type. Left side text blocks, top to bottom: 「創造の源、すべてを壊し、すべてを生む。」, 「正しさよりも、心が動く瞬間を信じる。」, 「美しいものに飢えている。」, 「静けさの中で、世界をかき混ぜる。」. Right side text blocks, top to bottom: 「感情を深く、人の痛みも、希望も、まるごと抱きしめる。」, 「枠を壊し、誰も見たことのない景色を描きたい。」, 「怖い、危ない、それでも止められない。」, plus a short atmospheric handwritten-style accent near the mid-right edge. At the lower center, add a large Japanese question line: {argument name="bottom question" default="これは、力？それとも、呪い？"}. At the very bottom, add a smaller Japanese line: {argument name="tagline text" default="私の中のバケモノは、私だけの物語を待っている。"}. Make the whole image feel obsessive, beautiful, unsettling, and emotionally intense, like a high-end dark art poster about inner monsters and creative power.

data.originalText: Create a soft, elegant Japanese lifestyle magazine editorial page in a warm botanical watercolor style, formatted as a full-page A4 portrait layout with a cream paper background, thin beige border, muted sage-green accents, and a refined nature-themed design. The page is a single cohesive magazine spread design with 6 distinct content sections: 1 large main illustration panel on the left, 1 tall title-and-article column on the upper right, 3 stacked informational point boxes on the mid-to-lower right, 2 small photo-card style image panels along the lower left, 1 circular quote badge near the lower left of the main panel, and 1 summary box at the lower right. The theme is elephant appreciation day in Japan. At the top left, place small editorial header text reading "LIFESTYLE / FEATURE / TOPIC" with a short Japanese subtitle beneath it. Across the upper right, add the large date heading "4.28 EVENT" and the main Japanese headline "象の日特集" in an elegant serif style, with a short subheading line beneath it and a tiny elephant icon. Below that, set 3 short Japanese body paragraphs in a clean magazine column, explaining elephant day. The main illustration panel shows a gentle elephant standing on the left, rendered in delicate watercolor with realistic wrinkles, large ears, soft ivory-gray skin, and a lowered trunk reaching toward a small child standing beside it. The child is an androgynous anime-style boy with messy wavy dark purple-black hair, pale skin, large eyes, a black graphic T-shirt with a purple emblem, loose brown knee-length cargo shorts, and bare feet, standing casually with one hand in a pocket while touching the elephant’s trunk with the other. Behind them is a sunny zoo walkway with a wooden fence, soft green trees, dappled light, and leafy branches hanging from above. Near the elephant, include a small wooden sign reading "Elephant 4.28". Add a circular text badge in Japanese near the lower left of the main image. On the lower left area, place exactly 2 small bordered snapshot-style panels with taped-corner scrapbook presentation: the first labeled "Feeding Time" showing the child in side profile offering leaves to the elephant’s trunk across a fence; the second labeled "Peaceful Time" showing the child seated on a wooden bench in profile with elephants in the background, in a calm reflective scene. Each small panel has a short Japanese caption underneath. On the right side, stack exactly 3 informational boxes labeled "POINT 01", "POINT 02", and "POINT 03" in olive green circles, each with a simple line icon and Japanese text: box 1 features an elephant icon and discusses memory, box 2 features a trunk or elephant-face icon and discusses delicacy despite size, box 3 features a zoo building icon and discusses what can be learned at the zoo. At the bottom right, add 1 bordered summary box with a ribbon-like header reading "まとめ", a small elephant silhouette, and 2 short Japanese summary paragraphs. Along the bottom margin, include the page number "068", the date "APRIL 2025", and a row of small walking elephant silhouettes. Add subtle botanical flourishes, leaves, and light decorative strokes throughout. Overall mood: gentle, educational, heartwarming, airy, natural, child-friendly, and sophisticated, like a premium seasonal magazine feature.

data.originalText: A full-body fantasy anime-style illustration of a glamorous young idol-like woman performing on an ornate gilded stage inside a grand baroque palace hall. She stands in a dramatic low-angle pose on a carved gold balcony or platform, one leg forward and slightly crossed, with her left arm thrust toward the viewer in strong foreshortening and her other hand resting lightly at her chest. She has a slim, elegant build, very long flowing dark brown hair streaming in the air, and a decorative floral and ribbon headpiece. Her expression should feel confident, theatrical, and captivating. She wears an elaborate frilled performance dress in {argument name="dress colors" default="royal blue, crimson red, white, and gold"}: a fitted corset bodice with gold trim and red front panel, white lace bust and sleeves, layered short ruffled skirt, and large swirling overskirts and cape-like fabric panels edged with gold embroidery that billow dramatically around her. Add ornate ankle accessories with matching ribbon flowers, white heeled shoes or short boots, and luxurious detailed fabric textures. The setting is a richly decorated interior with 1 large glowing gothic arched window on the left, 1 heavy dark red velvet curtain framing the top and left side, 1 large classical oil painting in an ornate frame on the right wall, 1 tall carved column behind her, 1 abundant arrangement of roses and pale flowers at the lower left, and 1 gilded balustrade across the foreground. Warm golden backlight streams through the stained-glass-like window, creating a luminous halo, soft haze, rim light on her hair and costume, and deep cinematic shadows. A few rose petals drift in the air. Highly detailed, ultra-polished, romantic, majestic, dynamic composition, rich textures, painterly anime illustration with realistic lighting and luxurious fantasy idol aesthetics.

She wears a soft lavender medieval-inspired princess dress with puff sleeves, white lace trim, and a fitted bodice, plus a pink-and-white bunny ear headband. Her extremely long {argument name="hair color" default="dark brown"} hair is styled into a single enormous thick braid that spills over the windowsill and drops straight down the full height of the image. A small fluffy white rabbit sits on her right shoulder, adding a cute fantasy touch. The tower is pale beige stone with a rounded balcony-like window ledge, an arched opening, deep purple interior curtains, and green ivy climbing around the walls and window frame. In the background, show a bright sunlit storybook landscape with a vivid blue sky, scattered white clouds, rolling green hills, a winding river, a stone bridge with 3 arches, and a distant European-style town with a castle or cathedral. The mood is triumphant, charming, and magical, like a polished high-end fantasy anime key visual. Detailed painterly rendering, soft natural daylight, clean linework, gentle atmospheric perspective, lush foliage, elegant composition, vertical format.

warehouse atmosphere, realistic costumes and creature suit, dramatic low-key lighting, smoke, sparks, filmic contrast","subject":{"heroine":{"role":"female superheroine","name":"{argument name=\"character name\" default=\"Torako\"}","appearance":"young Japanese woman with a straight dark bob haircut","costume":"white glossy bodysuit with black organic chest pattern, white gloves, white boots, battle-damaged and scorched with black burn marks on the shoulders, sleeves, and torso"},"villain":{"role":"monster attacker","appearance":"bulky humanoid creature in a green reptilian or plant-like suit with ridged texture, tentacled facial area, and rounded purple shoulder growths"}},"environment":{"location":"dim warehouse or factory interior","details":["concrete floor","metal barrels","dark corrugated walls","industrial pipes","single bright overhead lamp","haze and smoke"]},"layout":{"format":"3x3 storyboard grid","panel_count":9,"numbered_panels":["1","2","3","4","5","6","7","8","9"],"border":"thin white dividers between panels"},"panels":[{"panel":"1","shot":"medium wide shot","action":"the heroine is on her hands and knees on the floor, weakened and struggling to rise, head lowered"},{"panel":"2","shot":"over-the-shoulder shot from behind the heroine","action":"she looks forward at the monster standing several meters away in the warehouse"},{"panel":"3","shot":"medium shot","action":"the monster looms directly behind the heroine as she crawls forward, creating a stalking ambush composition"},{"panel":"4","shot":"tight medium shot","action":"the monster presses a glowing green hand or energy source against the heroine's upper chest at close range","effects":["green light bloom","threatening physical contact"]},{"panel":"5","shot":"dramatic impact close-up","action":"a bright energy blast detonates from the heroine's chest","effects":["intense white-green flash","flying sparks","smoke burst","torso arched backward","arms spread in shock"]},{"panel":"6","shot":"close-up","action":"the heroine recoils amid dense smoke and lingering sparks after the blast"},{"panel":"7","shot":"wide low-angle shot","action":"the heroine collapses back onto hands and knees, steam or smoke rising from her damaged suit"},{"panel":"8","shot":"low front angle","action":"she crawls weakly toward camera while the monster stands behind her, dominant and advancing"},{"panel":"9","shot":"close-up portrait","action":"exhausted heroine lifts her face slightly near the monster's leg, conveying pain and defeat"}],"cinematography":{"camera":"mostly low and medium angles, storyboard-style coverage with varied shot distance","lighting":"moody overhead practical light with hard highlights on the white suit and deep shadows","mood":"tense, dangerous, helpless, dramatic"},"negative_prompt":["anime style","cartoon rendering","clean pristine costume","bright daylight","multiple heroines","weapons","blood gore","text captions besides panel numbers","comedic expression"]}

{
  "instruction": "Use the provided two character images as exact visual references. Preserve identity, face, outfit, proportions, and details perfectly.",
  "concept": "{argument name="game concept" default="AAA fighting game scene presented as a Tekken-style gameplay grid storyboard"}",
  "layout": {
    "type": "3x3 grid",
    "description": "nine panels showing a continuous fight progression with full game UI visible in each frame"
  },
  "panels": [
    "panel 1: dramatic VS screen — character A vs character B, both facing each other, glowing background, versus text in center",
    "panel 2: round start — both fighters in idle stance, READY text on screen",
    "panel 3: FIGHT moment — cinematic spark explosion as fight begins",
    "panel 4: first attack — character A throws a punch with motion blur",
    "panel 5: counter attack — character B kicks with impact sparks",
    "panel 6: combo sequence — multiple hit sparks, motion trails, dynamic camera",
    "panel 7: low health moment — health bar flashing red, tension moment",
    "panel 8: finishing move — slow motion heavy hit, cinematic angle",
    "panel 9: KO screen — opponent falling back, huge KO text, particles flying"
  ],
  "style": "{argument name="art style" default="ultra realistic AAA Tekken-style fighting game, cinematic gameplay rendering, highly detailed characters, realistic lighting"}",
  "camera": "in-game fighting camera, slightly angled side view, dynamic zoom during impacts",
  "environment": "high-end fighting arena, dark background with neon accents, subtle depth, not distracting",
  "ui_elements": {
    "health_bars": "top left and right, detailed, glowing, decreasing across panels",
    "timer": "center top",
    "player_names": "top left and right",
    "round_indicator": "visible",
    "combo_counter": "appears during hits",
    "hit_effects": "sparks, flashes, light streaks",
    "KO_text": "large, bold, center screen in final panel",
    "READY_FIGHT_text": "arcade-style bold typography"
  },
  "effects": [
    "motion blur on attacks",
    "impact sparks",
    "energy trails",
    "camera shake effect",
    "slow motion feeling in finishing hit",
    "screen glow during hits"
  ],
  "color_grading": "{argument name="color grading" default="high contrast, arcade cinematic, vibrant highlights, deep shadows"}",
  "output": "clean 3x3 grid, perfectly aligned panels, full UI visible, no logos, no watermarks"
}
"reference_style": "Tekken 8 gameplay UI, arcade fighting game interface, modern AAA fighting HUD"

data.originalText: A heartwarming stylized 3D animated forest village scene at golden hour, showing 2 adorable insect characters meeting on a cobblestone path between tiny mushroom-roof cottages. In the left foreground, a cute {argument name="main insect type" default="ladybug"} crouches low with an oversized glossy black head, huge expressive brown eyes, a small smiling mouth, short antennae with rounded tips, and a tiny {argument name="accessory color" default="red"} bow near one antenna. Its shell is bright {argument name="shell color" default="red"} with distinct black spots, and its body is dark charcoal black with soft rounded limbs. In the right midground, a cheerful small {argument name="second insect type" default="bee"} hovers slightly above the ground facing the larger insect, with a similarly oversized head, big sparkling eyes, delicate translucent wings, tiny antennae, and little forelegs lifted as if speaking excitedly. The setting is an enchanted bug-sized woodland hamlet with 3 visible cottages, rounded wooden doors, curved stone walls, moss, vines, flowers, and leafy plants framing the path. Warm cinematic sunlight filters through the trees from the upper right, creating glowing rim light, soft bokeh, and floating firefly-like particles. Use a shallow depth of field, low camera angle at insect eye level, rich autumn-green and golden tones, highly detailed textures, soft global illumination, whimsical family-film mood, Pixar-like stylized realism, and a subtle dreamy double-exposure feel with faint overlapping light or ghosted highlights in parts of the frame.

Each frame should show a different moment from the same scene, with clear progression. Vary the composition, camera angle, and distances to create a sense of movement and storytelling. Use a cinematic, {argument name="color tone" default="cooler-toned"}, high-contrast, deep-space blacks film with a natural color grade. Add subtle film grain, slight motion blur, and natural imperfections to emulate analog photography. Keep the composition candid and emotionally grounded, with a sense of movement and quiet storytelling. Overall aesthetic: cinematic, nostalgic, and organic, like raw film stills.

data.originalText: A dramatic Japanese light-novel cover illustration in high-detail anime fantasy style, square composition, showing a heroic ensemble posed for battle in a ruined mountain pass at sunset with cherry blossoms blowing through the air. The scene centers on {argument name="hero title" default="Momotaro"}, a young black-haired male warrior in glossy red samurai armor, crouched in the foreground and gripping a katana diagonally across his body. Beside him in the front-right foreground is a black-haired young woman in matching red armor with a high ponytail, also drawing a katana in a dynamic combat-ready pose. Around them stand 5 additional companions for a total of 7 characters: 1 brown-haired short-haired girl at front-left holding a short blade, 1 silver-haired angelic woman at upper-left with large white wings and a drawn bow, 1 tall red-haired warrior at top-center carrying a large weapon over the shoulder, 1 long straight black-haired shrine-maiden-like girl at upper-center-right in white and red with light armor, and 1 blonde girl at right holding a large ornate war hammer. Add a distant Japanese castle on the right background, jagged rocks and broken ground, glowing embers, drifting petals, and a luminous cloudy sky with strong backlight behind the group. Use cinematic fantasy lighting, epic adventure mood, polished painterly rendering, sharp detailed armor, flowing hair, layered depth, and a bold heroic poster feel. Include large Japanese title text across the top in metallic gold with black outline reading {argument name="top title text" default="《御伽話ファンタジー》シン・桃太郎伝"}, with a smaller Japanese subtitle beneath it in white with dark outline reading {argument name="top subtitle text" default="～追放・転生した元神は、おとぎ話の世界の美少女たちと世界を救う!!"}. Include large Japanese promotional text across the bottom in bright red with white outline reading {argument name="bottom catch text" default="追放、転生した神・桃太郎。御伽話の美少女たちと試練乗り越えて鬼退治！"}. Make it look like a commercial fantasy web novel or manga cover image, energetic, crowded, and visually striking.

data.originalText: Create a dramatic Japanese light-novel cover illustration for a fantasy mecha isekai story. Vertical poster composition with a huge heroic humanoid robot dominating the center foreground, viewed from a slightly low angle to make it monumental. The robot is sleek and ornate, with white and silver armor, rich gold trim, glowing cyan energy lines, a radiant emerald-green core in the chest, a crown-like crest on the helmet, and a long royal blue cape with gold edging. Behind its back spread multiple crystalline energy wings, about 8 large translucent green shards fanning out symmetrically like luminous blades. In its left hand it holds a long fantasy-tech spear with a blue glowing blade and gold mechanical detailing. At the robot’s feet are 2 human characters: on the left, a red-haired fantasy heroine with very long braided hair, leather-and-fabric adventurer clothing, and a determined expression, looking up at the robot; on the right, a young male protagonist with short dark hair in a fantasy tunic and cloak, reaching one hand up toward the giant machine in awe and urgency, seen mostly from behind. The setting is an epic ruined sci-fi fantasy world with towering gothic spires, broken city structures, drifting smoke, dramatic clouds, and a sky filled with stars, planets, streaks of lightning, and 8 small flying warships scattered in the distance. Highly polished anime key visual style, ultra-detailed, cinematic lighting, intense contrast, blue-green-gold color palette, heroic atmosphere, intricate mechanical rendering, fantasy worldbuilding, premium game or novel cover finish. Add large Japanese title typography at the top: 《{argument name="tagline text" default="本格異世界SFロボット戦記"}》 above a massive metallic logo reading {argument name="series title" default="ASTRAIA"}, with a smaller Japanese subtitle line beneath it. Add a large dramatic Japanese catchphrase at the bottom in glowing white and gold text over 2 lines: {argument name="bottom catchphrase" default="乗って！ユウキ！ その叫びが、世界の運命を決めた！"}. Keep the overall design dense, premium, and readable as a commercial cover, with the central robot as the unmistakable focal point.

data.originalText:
A cinematic anime-style vertical book-cover illustration for a romantic comedy light novel with slight fantasy atmosphere, split by a thin apartment wall down the center. On the left side, a warm, cozy kitchen glows in amber light from a hanging pendant lamp. A {argument name="female character name" default="Nanako Iida"}, age 28, stands in three-quarter view holding a deep plate of freshly cooked food with visible steam rising in elegant curls. She has dark hair tied in a messy bun, soft bangs, a gentle mature expression, and wears a lavender knit sweater under a white apron. The kitchen contains exact visible details: 1 hanging lamp, 1 upper shelf with cookware, 5 hanging utensils, 1 cutting board, 1 knife block, and 6 small bottles or jars lined across the foreground counter. On the right side, a dim, cool-toned bachelor bedroom is lit in blue shadows. A {argument name="male character name" default="Sota Ninomiya"}, age 26, slim but muscular, with tousled dark hair and a fitted charcoal T-shirt, leans one hand against the wall as if sensing the aroma through it. His room contains 1 bed, 1 bookshelf, 1 desk lamp, and 1 wall poster. A ribbon of steam drifts from the dish across the center wall into his side, visually connecting them. The mood is intimate, sensual, and slightly teasing, emphasizing the contrast between warm home cooking and lonely nighttime restraint. Add elegant Japanese vertical catch copy on the wall and upper right, small white serif-style name labels beside both characters with their ages, and a large bold Japanese title block across the lower middle. Include these exact text elements: left name label "Nanako Iida 28歳", right name label "Sota Ninomiya 26歳", vertical wall text "その香りが、ふたりの距離を、そっと溶かしていく。", upper-right vertical text "隣人は、優しい香りと、秘密のレシピ。", large center title "《飯テロ恋愛小説》
夜中に読まないでください〜
〜お隣のストイックくんは、
隣のお姉さんの愛の飯テロに勝てない〜", and bottom tagline "毎晩続く深夜の罪な料理の香り。
壁一枚の距離と心を溶かす". Highly polished promotional cover art, soft bloom lighting, detailed fabric folds, realistic steam, romantic tension, glossy illustrated publishing design.

data.originalText: A dramatic dark fantasy light-novel cover illustration in a square format, featuring a fierce female warrior centered in a dynamic lunging pose inside a dim, ruined, cathedral-like or industrial gothic interior with a smoky blurred background and warm floating embers. She has long silver-white hair in a high ponytail whipping violently to the right, pale skin, and a deliberately obscured or featureless face. Her body is enhanced with four black mechanical arms in total, built from intricate clockwork and segmented metal joints, extending spider-like around her. She wears a tattered black dress-like battle outfit with armored corset detailing, belts, straps, a garter on one thigh, and biomechanical leg armor. Count exactly 4 arms visible: 2 upper arms and 2 lower arms; count exactly 4 glowing energy blades, one held in each hand, translucent neon blue with crystalline edges and magical circuitry-like light patterns. Emphasize the contrast between matte black metal, torn fabric, pale skin, and electric cyan weapons. The composition should feel cinematic, high-detail, intense, and heroic, with sharp focus on the character and soft depth-of-field in the background. Add ornate Japanese cover typography in metallic gold with subtle beveling and glow: at the top, small genre text 《バトルアクション》; below it, a large main title {argument name="headline text" default="クアッドアームの静寂"}; beneath that, a smaller subtitle ～四本腕の女傭兵と錆びついた世界の約束～. data.originalText: A two-page black-and-white manga spread set in a nighttime high school band rehearsal studio, drawn in polished modern shonen/seinen manga style with detailed screentones, dramatic lighting, expressive speed lines, and glossy instrument rendering. The scene shows 4 visible band members in school uniforms: a surprised teenage boy with messy short hair at guitar and vocal mic, a calm beautiful teenage girl with very long flowing light hair playing electric guitar in the foreground, a petite long-haired teenage girl at a keyboard, and a drummer in the back whose face is intentionally obscured by a soft blur. The studio has large windows revealing a city skyline at night, hanging ceiling lights, amps including a visible Marshall stack, a drum kit with a band logo on the bass drum, cables, and a wall sign reading “Beat Box.” Compose it as a printed manga spread with 7 panels total across 2 pages, including gutters, page borders, and page numbers 13 and 14 at the bottom. Left page: 3 panels — top panel with the shocked boy turning toward the girls and a large Japanese speech bubble saying “え!?”; middle panel is a close-up of the long-haired guitarist girl with a calm expression and a Japanese speech bubble saying “……別にいいよ”; bottom panel is a wider full-band rehearsal shot with all 4 members in the studio. Right page: 4 panels — top panel is an explosive performance shot with the boy singing and playing while the long-haired girl plays guitar, with large sound-effect text “ジャッ”; middle panel is a dynamic close-up of the long-haired guitarist playing intensely, with flowing hair, musical note symbols, radiant speed lines, and the keyboard girl visible in the back; bottom panel is a close-up of the boy’s stunned face with soft bokeh and a vertical Japanese speech bubble saying “……あれ”. Emphasize the emotional contrast: awkward surprise turning into admiration as the girl’s guitar performance changes the mood. Use monochrome only, no color, authentic manga lettering, cinematic framing, layered depth, and highly detailed hair and instrument strings.

data.originalText: A black-and-white manga page spread with 5 panels on a clean white background and thin black gutters, drawn in highly detailed modern seinen/shoujo hybrid line art with soft screentones, reflective highlights, and a quiet melancholic mood. The setting is a nighttime music studio classroom with large windows showing a city skyline full of lit buildings against a dark sky. Main subject: a slender high school girl with very long straight light hair and blunt bangs, delicate features, and a serious introspective expression, wearing a Japanese school uniform consisting of a white button-up shirt, loosened striped ribbon tie, and plaid skirt, seated and playing a solid-body electric guitar that resembles a Stratocaster. In the large upper-left panel, show her in three-quarter view holding the guitar across her lap, left hand on the fretboard and right hand near the pickups, surrounded by studio equipment including 1 drum kit in the back left, 2 stacked guitar amplifiers on the right, and a wall sign reading "Beat Box" near the door. In the narrow upper-right panel, show a close-up of the guitar neck and her fretting hand, with the small vertical Japanese sound effect text "トン…". In the tall middle-right panel, show a close side-profile close-up of the girl looking down at the instrument with a pensive, almost disappointed expression, with the night city lights blurred through the window behind her. In the lower-left panel, show 1 teenage boy in a school blazer and loosened tie, seated indoors and turned slightly to the side; his face is obscured by a large soft gray rectangular censor block, and beside him is 1 vertical speech balloon containing the Japanese text "……やっぱり違う". In the lower-right panel, show a closer view of the same boy from the chest up against a soft bokeh screentone background; his face is again obscured by a large gray censor block. Add printed page numbers centered at the bottom margins: "5" under the left page and "6" under the right page. Emphasize a subtle narrative theme of realizing that the sound feels wrong, as if this is a continuation page from a dramatic school-band manga. Keep everything monochrome, polished, cinematic, and emotionally restrained.

data.originalText: Create a polished vertical real-estate promotional flyer in a clean, modern social-media ad style, 4:5 poster composition. Use a bright daytime outdoor theme with a pale blue sky, soft clouds, and leafy green tree branches framing the top left and top right corners. The layout should feel like a premium property investment advertisement with bold typography, glossy marketing design, and a teal, red, white, and gray color palette. At the upper left, place a small uppercase headline reading {argument name="headline text" default="LIVE BETTER. INVEST SMARTER."}. Directly below it, add a very large stacked main headline: {argument name="main headline line 1" default="OWN YOUR"} in deep teal and {argument name="main headline line 2" default="DREAM HOME"} in vivid red, using a bold condensed sans-serif font. Beneath that, add a teal ribbon banner with white uppercase text reading {argument name="tagline text" default="LUXURY LIVING. LASTING VALUE."}. Under the tagline, show exactly 3 circular feature icons arranged horizontally with thin vertical separators between them: a shield icon with the caption "SECURE YOUR FUTURE", a rising bar-chart icon with the caption "HIGH VALUE INVESTMENT", and a house icon with the caption "MODERN & ELEGANT". In the middle left and lower center, feature a large photorealistic contemporary luxury house with 2 stories, white and gray exterior walls, black trim, large glass windows, a balcony, landscaped shrubs, and a paved driveway, shown from a front three-quarter angle. On the right side, place a waist-up adult Black man in a green knit sweater, facing forward and pointing directly at the viewer with an assertive sales-poster pose; his body overlaps the house and extends into the foreground. Near his lower torso, add a glossy red circular badge with a slight 3D effect containing large white uppercase text {argument name="callout text" default="BUY NOW!"}, and attach a small dark teal angled banner across its bottom edge reading "LIMITED UNITS AVAILABLE!". Across the bottom, create a dark teal panel containing exactly 3 rounded rectangular property cards with white borders and equal spacing. Card 1 should show a row of modern townhouses and the label "MODERN TERRACES"; beneath it place exactly 2 small features: "Spacious Rooms" and "24/7 Security". Card 2 should show a luxury villa with a pool and the label "LUXURY VILLAS"; beneath it place exactly 2 small features: "Premium Amenities" and "Prime Locations". Card 3 should show a detached upscale modern home and the label "EXCLUSIVE HOMES"; beneath it place exactly 2 small features: "Registered Title" and "Trusted Developer". At the very bottom, include one large empty white rounded rectangle spanning most of the width as a placeholder area for contact details or footer information. Make the overall image crisp, high-contrast, commercial, aspirational, and professionally designed like a premium real-estate marketing poster.

data.originalText: A surreal high-fashion editorial photograph on an empty roadside in a bleak Icelandic-looking landscape under a flat gray overcast sky. Center the composition on a small brutalist concrete bus stop shelter with stained weathered walls and a simple bench inside, and place 1 slender adult man inside the shelter wearing a tailored black suit, black shirt, and black shoes, standing casually and looking to the side. Draped over the entire bus stop is 1 enormous oversized puffer jacket in vivid burnt orange, inflated and tent-like, forming a monumental sculptural canopy over the shelter; the collar gapes open above the roof, the sleeves slump down on both sides to the wet pavement, and the glossy quilted nylon shows realistic wrinkles, puffed chambers, seams, snaps, and fashion-product detail. The road in the foreground is dark and rain-slick, with subtle reflections and a cold damp atmosphere. In the background, show low barren hills with traces of snow and a remote windswept shoreline feel. Shoot it like a luxury magazine fashion campaign with cinematic realism, centered framing, muted natural light, strong contrast between the monochrome environment and the orange coat, minimal color palette, slightly monumental scale distortion, and crisp editorial photography detail.

data.originalText: A hyper-dynamic anime cyberpop illustration of a cat-eared girl thrusting a soda bottle toward the camera in an extreme close-up, with strong fisheye perspective and dramatic foreshortening. The bottle dominates the foreground in her hand, label clearly reading "CAT NYAN SODA" with smaller Japanese-style text beneath, and the cap is off as glowing fizzy liquid erupts upward in a huge splash. The character is a stylish futuristic young woman with {argument name="hair color" default="silver-white with blue and pink iridescence"} hair, very long and voluminous, whipping through the frame in neon ribbons. She has 2 visible cat ears, fluffy and oversized, decorated with 3 small accessories: a spiked ear cuff, a tiny cat-face clip, and a small metallic piercing detail. Her face is mostly hidden by a solid {argument name="censor block color" default="purple"} square centered over the upper face area. She wears a cropped white tank top with a small barcode-like graphic, a dark glossy jacket slipping off the shoulders, layered necklaces, and a belt at the waist. Her nails are painted bright pink. The product is a plastic soda bottle filled with dark purple liquid and glowing highlights, with a bold playful logo in white and pink. Surround the scene with floating ice cubes, sparkling droplets, and explosive carbonation effects. Use a high-contrast palette of electric magenta, violet, cyan, and deep blue, with luminous reflections on skin, hair, glassy surfaces, and liquid. Background is an abstract nightlife energy burst of streaks, splashes, particles, and refracted light, no clear environment, just intense motion and color. Make it glossy, saturated, chaotic, and stylish like a premium anime beverage ad poster, with sharp linework, radiant bloom, glittering specular highlights, and a rebellious pop-cyber aesthetic. Vertical composition, waist-up view, single character, 1 bottle, 1 major soda splash, 6 visible floating ice cubes.

data.originalText: A polished children's pop-up book advertisement on a dark studio background, featuring an open hardcover book with thick white pages and a teal-green cover lying on a tabletop. From the center fold, a highly detailed white paper origami T-rex bursts upward in a dynamic roaring pose, mouth wide open with sharp triangular teeth, tiny clawed arms raised, thick folded legs planted in layered paper jungle foliage, and a segmented tail extending backward. The dinosaur should look handcrafted from crisp folded cardstock, with visible geometric paper panels and clean origami seams. Behind it, the right-hand page stands partially upright and catches a dramatic shadow projection of the T-rex profile, creating a large silhouette with open jaws; also include small paper-cut scenery on that page: 3 flying pterosaurs and a simple mountain landscape. Surround the dinosaur base with dense cut-paper plants and grass emerging from both pages. Light the scene with a cinematic warm spotlight from the upper left, leaving the background in deep navy to black, with soft realistic shadows cast across the book and onto the raised page. At the top center, include bold white ad typography in stacked lines reading {argument name="headline text" default="DINOSAURS POP UP ADVENTURE"}, with a white ribbon banner below that reads {argument name="tagline" default="A WORLD OF WONDER IN EVERY PAGE"}. At the bottom center, place 4 evenly spaced circular feature icons with captions in white: an open book icon labeled "AMAZING POP UP DESIGNS", a hand icon labeled "HANDCRAFTED WITH CARE", a shield icon labeled "DURABLE & KID FRIENDLY", and a light bulb icon labeled "INSPIRES IMAGINATION". Premium toy catalog style, cinematic product photography mixed with paper craft illustration, centered composition, high contrast, ultra-clean, whimsical, family-friendly, realistic paper texture.

data.originalText: A cinematic studio photograph of an open {argument name="book type" default="pop-up book"} on a clean white surface, viewed from a low front angle, with a dramatic {argument name="main subject" default="T-rex"} made entirely of intricate white origami and laser-cut paper bursting upward from the center fold. The dinosaur is large and dominant, facing right in a roaring pose with open jaws, sharp paper teeth, tiny forearms, powerful legs, and a long tail sweeping left. Its body is built from hundreds of delicate layered paper slats and cutout perforations, glowing from strong internal and under-page illumination so the creature appears backlit and semi-luminous. Around the base, exactly 7 paper plant silhouettes rise from the pages: 3 darker branching shrubs in the foreground and 4 pale fern-like foliage shapes behind them, all also cut from paper. The open pages show faint printed text on the right-hand spread, while the center gutter emits a bright white light that shines upward through the structure. A soft cool-blue ambient environment contrasts with the warm white glow from inside the book, creating a magical children's advertisement feel. Strong spotlighting from above and behind the dinosaur produces crisp shadows cast across the next spread and onto the tabletop. Minimal background, high detail, elegant product-ad aesthetic, volumetric haze, shallow depth of field, monochrome white and blue palette, ultra-clean composition, surreal handcrafted realism.

A slim athletic woman with dark skin and long dreadlocks tied up in a high bun stands leaning casually against the bong near the center-left, her face intentionally obscured with a soft rectangular blur, wearing a dark olive sports bra, loose cream jogger pants, white crew socks with green stripes, and chunky off-white sneakers. She poses with one leg crossed in front of the other and one arm resting on the bong’s angled bowl. Behind them, place enormous bold dark green condensed numbers reading {argument name="headline text" default="4:20"} spanning almost the full height of the background on a warm light beige wall. In the lower left corner, add a small block of uppercase Spanish copy in a clean sans-serif font reading {argument name="quote" default="DEJÓ DE SER EXCEPCIÓN. — YA FORMA PARTE DEL PAISAJE."}. The overall look should feel like a luxury lifestyle ad campaign: clean composition, muted earthy palette, soft diffused studio lighting, subtle shadows, sharp product detail, fashion-editorial styling, realistic glass reflections, and a polished contemporary cannabis culture aesthetic.

The acrylic packaging has bold red, white, and blue trim bands around the top and bottom edges, evoking American flag colors. Add a front label plaque reading {argument name="front label" default="EGGS BENEDICT"} with smaller text {argument name="origin and date" default="USA - 1894"}. The label should prominently read “100% WPC PROTEIN MILK” and include small nutrition callouts such as “82G PROTEIN,” “2G SUGAR/SERVING,” “119% RDI OF VC,” “100% CHOLINE,” a circular “GMP” badge, a black strip reading “WHEY MILK PROTEIN CONCENTRATE,” another strip reading “LOW SUGAR / LOW FAT / RICH NATURAL,” and a flavor tag reading {argument name="flavor text" default="BLACK COOKIES FLAVOUR"}. Surround the tub with an explosive upward and outward splash of glossy chocolate liquid, with dramatic arcs, droplets, and suspended motion frozen in midair. Include exactly 5 whole chocolate sandwich cookies flying around the product and multiple broken cookie chunks and crumbs scattered throughout the scene, with one partially visible cookie near the lower right and another near the upper left. The glass at the bottom should be only partially visible, transparent, and overflowing from the impact of the splash. Use a high-contrast studio background with a dark deep blue gradient on the left fading to bright white on the right, cinematic rim lighting, crisp reflections, ultra-sharp focus on the tub, and detailed texture in the liquid and cookie crumbs. The overall look should be premium sports nutrition advertising, dynamic, energetic, and suitable for a hero image on a modern ecommerce fitness website.

data.originalText: Using REFERENCE_0, extract only the outfit and turn it into a clean fashion magazine product showcase on a light warm-beige background. Remove the person entirely and display the clothing as separate laid-flat items: 1 cropped short-sleeve top centered near the top and 1 pair of shorts centered below it. Preserve the vivid multicolor art print from the reference, but present the garments neatly, as if for an editorial catalog page, with soft studio shadows. Add 1 circular fabric-detail inset at the lower left showing a close-up of the print. Add elegant editorial typography and thin callout lines, with 4 text blocks total: a large headline block at upper left reading “COLORFUL ART SET UP” with small Japanese copy above and below, 1 right-side block labeled “TOPS” with Japanese description, 1 lower-right block labeled “BOTTOMS” with Japanese description, and 1 lower-left block labeled “FABRIC” with short Japanese description. Keep the overall look refined, minimal, premium, and like a clothing introduction page in a magazine.

data.originalText:
Create a high-impact 9:16 vertical e-commerce infographic for {argument name="product name" default="Bolt True Wireless Earbuds"} with a premium lifestyle advertising aesthetic.
Composition & Framing
Full-body shot of a young woman (match face and identity exactly to the provided reference image — accurate facial features, skin tone, hairstyle)
Camera angle slightly low and close (fashion campaign perspective) to add depth and presence
The subject is sitting casually on the floor, one knee raised, one leg extended forward toward the camera
Foreground (Product Focus)
The woman is holding an open {argument name="brand" default="Bolt"} earbud charging case toward the camera
Inside the case: one earbud visible
The second earbud is worn in her ear
Case should be glossy white with subtle branding (“BOLT”)
Add slight macro depth-of-field blur on the hand and case for cinematic realism
Subject Styling
Outfit: modern sporty streetwear
lightweight jacket (off-white / neutral tone)
crop top or sports bra
loose joggers (light pink or soft color)
white sneakers with visible texture
Expression: confident, relaxed, slight smile
Pose: natural, lifestyle-oriented — not stiff or overly posed
Background & Atmosphere
Clean studio background with soft gray gradient
Add:
rainbow prism lens flares
subtle light leaks
floating blurred earbuds and charging case in background
Ground surface slightly textured (studio floor look)
Lighting
Soft, diffused commercial lighting
Highlight:
skin texture
glossy earbud case
fabric details
Subtle rim lighting for separation from background
Typography Layout (Modern Sans-Serif, White)
Top Center (Behind Model):
BOLD HUGE TEXT:
“BOLT” (partially hidden behind subject)
Top Right:
Bolt Earbuds
True Wireless
Mid Left:
Powerful sound.
Effortless vibes.
Engineered for every beat of your day.
Mid Right:
BIG: 30
small: hours of playtime
Below that:
BIG: IPX5
small: water resistant
Bottom Right:
BIG: 1
small: year warranty
Style & Quality
8K ultra-realistic commercial photography
Sharp focus on face + earbuds
Slight depth blur for foreground and background elements
Clean Apple/Nike-style premium ad aesthetic
Balanced composition with strong negative space

data.originalText: Using the provided reference image, turn this casual phone snapshot of the drink into a polished professional beverage photo while keeping the same cup, soda, straw, outdoor theme-park setting, and general composition. Reframe and clean it up so the drink is the clear hero subject, make the cup sharper and more detailed with crisp condensation and sparkling ice, and enhance the Coca-Cola red tones and overall contrast. Apply warm golden-hour commercial lighting with richer highlights and a more cinematic color grade. Increase background blur for a shallow depth-of-field look, simplify visual distractions, and make the people in the background feel more incidental and softly out of focus while preserving the tree, benches, planters, and ferris wheel context. Keep it realistic, like a high-end advertisement shot taken by a professional product photographer.

textTranslations.zh-CN: 使用提供的参考图，将这张随手拍摄的手机照片转化为专业的饮品大片，同时保留原有的杯子、汽水、吸管、户外主题乐园背景及整体构图。通过重新构图和画面清理，使饮品成为视觉焦点；提升杯子的清晰度与细节，呈现出清脆的凝露和晶莹的冰块；增强 Coca-Cola 的红色调及整体对比度。应用温暖的黄金时刻商业光效，增加高光质感，并进行电影级的调色。增加背景虚化以营造浅景深效果，简化视觉干扰，使背景中的人物显得更加自然且模糊，同时保留树木、长椅、花坛和摩天轮等环境元素。保持画面真实感，呈现出如同专业产品摄影师拍摄的高端广告大片效果。
textTranslations.th-TH: ใช้ภาพอ้างอิงที่ให้มา เปลี่ยนภาพถ่ายเครื่องดื่มจากมือถือทั่วไปให้กลายเป็นภาพถ่ายเครื่องดื่มระดับมืออาชีพ โดยยังคงแก้ว โซดา หลอด ธีมสวนสนุกกลางแจ้ง และองค์ประกอบภาพโดยรวมไว้เหมือนเดิม จัดเฟรมใหม่และปรับแต่งให้เครื่องดื่มเป็นจุดเด่นที่ชัดเจน ทำให้แก้วมีความคมชัดและมีรายละเอียดมากขึ้นด้วยหยดน้ำเกาะและน้ำแข็งที่ดูสดใส พร้อมทั้งเพิ่มโทนสีแดงของ Coca-Cola และคอนทราสต์โดยรวมให้โดดเด่นยิ่งขึ้น ใช้แสงแบบโฆษณาในช่วงเวลา Golden Hour ที่ให้ไฮไลท์ที่ดูนุ่มนวลและโทนสีแบบภาพยนตร์ เพิ่มความเบลอของฉากหลังเพื่อให้ได้เอฟเฟกต์หน้าชัดหลังเบลอ ลดสิ่งรบกวนทางสายตา และทำให้ผู้คนที่อยู่ด้านหลังดูเป็นเพียงองค์ประกอบรองที่เบลออย่างนุ่มนวล โดยยังคงบริบทของต้นไม้ ม้านั่ง กระถางต้นไม้ และชิงช้าสวรรค์เอาไว้ ให้ภาพออกมาดูสมจริงเหมือนภาพถ่ายโฆษณาคุณภาพสูงที่ถ่ายโดยช่างภาพสินค้ามืออาชีพ
textTranslations.es-ES: Utilizando la imagen de referencia proporcionada, convierte esta instantánea casual de móvil en una fotografía de bebida profesional y pulida, manteniendo el mismo vaso, refresco, pajita, el entorno de parque temático al aire libre y la composición general. textTranslations.de-DE: Verwandeln Sie diesen beiläufigen Schnappschuss eines Getränks mithilfe des bereitgestellten Referenzbildes in ein ausgefeiltes, professionelles Getränkefoto, wobei der Becher, das Getränk, der Strohhalm, die Outdoor-Kulisse im Freizeitpark und die allgemeine Komposition beibehalten werden. Recadrez et nettoyez l'image pour que la boisson soit le sujet principal, rendez le verre plus net et détaillé avec une condensation cristalline et des glaçons étincelants, et rehaussez les tons rouges de Coca-Cola ainsi que le contraste global. Appliquez un éclairage commercial chaleureux de type « golden hour » avec des reflets plus riches et une colorimétrie cinématographique. Accentuez le flou d'arrière-plan pour obtenir une faible profondeur de champ, simplifiez les distractions visuelles et faites en sorte que les personnes en arrière-plan paraissent plus accessoires et floues, tout en préservant le contexte des arbres, des bancs, des jardinières et de la grande roue. Gardez un rendu réaliste, comme s'il s'agissait d'une publicité haut de gamme réalisée par un photographe culinaire professionnel.

Riquadra e pulisci l'immagine affinché la bevanda sia il soggetto principale, rendi il bicchiere più nitido e dettagliato con una condensa realistica e ghiaccio scintillante, ed esalta le tonalità rosse della Coca-Cola e il contrasto generale. Applica un'illuminazione commerciale calda tipica dell'ora d'oro, con riflessi più ricchi e una gradazione cromatica più cinematografica. data.originalText: A dramatic luxury product advertising image for a motorsport-inspired chronograph wristwatch in a dark studio. Center-left foreground, show a single stainless steel chronograph watch standing upright at a slight three-quarter angle, with a black dial, two red-accent subdials, slim silver hour markers, a tachymeter bezel, and visible crown and pushers on the right side. The watch has a black leather strap with bold red stitching along both edges and a sporty premium finish. To the right of the watch, place one black square presentation box slightly behind it, textured like leather, with red stitching around the lid and a silver embossed eye-shaped logo above the text “NESS STUDIO” and smaller red text “TRACK SURFACE.” At the top center of the composition, add the same silver eye logo with the words “NESS STUDIO” and smaller “BY NICOLAS.” Across the background, place one oversized blurred word, {argument name="headline text" default="PRECISION"}, in large gray capital letters spanning nearly the full width. The scene is set against a deep black background with cinematic red and white horizontal light streaks crossing behind the products from left to right, suggesting speed and racetrack energy. Use a glossy wet ground plane with reflective texture, catching red highlights and mirrorlike reflections beneath the watch and box. At the bottom center, add the text “CHRONOGRAPH SERIES” in clean white spaced capitals with thin red horizontal lines extending on both sides, and below it smaller red capitals reading {argument name="tagline text" default="ALSACE MADE"}. Color palette: black, charcoal gray, silver steel, vivid racing red, and a touch of white. Lighting should be high-contrast and premium, with crisp specular highlights on the metal case, subtle soft fill on the box, and moody shadows. Overall style: ultra-polished commercial product photography, luxury watch campaign, sharp focus on the products, sleek branding, high-end automotive aesthetic.

textTranslations.zh-CN: 一张极具张力的奢华产品广告图，展示了暗调摄影棚中赛车灵感计时腕表。画面左前方中心位置，放置一块不锈钢计时码表，呈微微侧向的三分之二角度直立，配有黑色表盘、两个红色点缀的小表盘、纤细的银色时标、测速计表圈，右侧可见表冠和按钮。腕表配有黑色皮质表带，边缘饰有醒目的红色缝线，呈现出运动型高端质感。腕表右侧放置一个略微靠后的黑色方形礼盒，具有皮革纹理，盒盖周围有红色缝线，上方印有银色浮雕眼形徽标，下方文字为“NESS STUDIO”，更小的红色文字为“TRACK SURFACE”。构图顶部中心位置，添加相同的银色眼形徽标，下方配有“NESS STUDIO”字样及较小的“BY NICOLAS”。背景处放置一个超大且模糊的单词，{argument name="headline text" default="PRECISION"}，采用巨大的灰色大写字母，几乎横跨整个画面宽度。场景设定在深黑色背景下，红色和白色的水平光束从左至右穿过产品后方，营造出速度感和赛道氛围。使用带有反射纹理的亮面湿润地面，在腕表和礼盒下方映出红色高光和镜面反射。底部中心位置添加“CHRONOGRAPH SERIES”字样，采用简洁的白色等间距大写字母，两侧延伸出细长的红色水平线，下方配有较小的红色大写字母 {argument name="tagline text" default="ALSACE MADE"}。配色方案：黑色、炭灰色、银色钢质、鲜艳的赛车红以及少许白色。灯光应具备高对比度和高级感，金属表壳上呈现清晰的镜面高光，礼盒上有柔和的补光，并带有深邃的阴影。整体风格：极致精美的商业产品摄影，奢华腕表宣传大片，产品焦点清晰，品牌感流畅，具备高端汽车美学。
textTranslations.es-ES: Una imagen publicitaria dramática de un producto de lujo para un reloj cronógrafo inspirado en el automovilismo en un estudio oscuro. En el primer plano, centro-izquierda, muestra un único reloj cronógrafo de acero inoxidable en posición vertical con un ligero ángulo de tres cuartos, con esfera negra, dos subesferas con detalles en rojo, marcadores de hora plateados delgados, un bisel con taquímetro y la corona y los pulsadores visibles en el lado derecho. El reloj tiene una correa de cuero negro con costuras rojas llamativas a lo largo de ambos bordes y un acabado deportivo premium. A la derecha del reloj, coloca una caja de presentación cuadrada negra ligeramente detrás, con textura similar al cuero, con costuras rojas alrededor de la tapa y un logotipo plateado en relieve con forma de ojo sobre el texto “NESS STUDIO” y un texto más pequeño en rojo que dice “TRACK SURFACE”. En la parte superior central de la composición, añade el mismo logotipo de ojo plateado con las palabras “NESS STUDIO” y, más pequeño, “BY NICOLAS”. A través del fondo, coloca una palabra borrosa de gran tamaño, {argument name="headline text" default="PRECISION"}, en letras mayúsculas grises grandes que abarcan casi todo el ancho. La escena se desarrolla sobre un fondo negro profundo con destellos de luz horizontales cinematográficos en rojo y blanco que cruzan detrás de los productos de izquierda a derecha, sugiriendo velocidad y la energía de una pista de carreras. Utiliza un plano de suelo húmedo y brillante con una textura reflectante, que capture reflejos rojos y efectos de espejo debajo del reloj y la caja. En la parte inferior central, añade el texto “CHRONOGRAPH SERIES” en mayúsculas blancas limpias y espaciadas con finas líneas horizontales rojas que se extienden a ambos lados, y debajo, en letras rojas más pequeñas, {argument name="tagline text" default="ALSACE MADE"}. Paleta de colores: negro, gris carbón, acero plateado, rojo carreras intenso y un toque de blanco. La iluminación debe ser de alto contraste y premium, con reflejos especulares nítidos en la caja de metal, un relleno suave y sutil en la caja y sombras ambientales. Estilo general: fotografía de producto comercial ultra pulida, campaña de relojes de lujo, enfoque nítido en los productos, branding elegante, estética automotriz de alta gama.

textTranslations.de-DE: Ein dramatisches Luxus-Werbebild für eine vom Motorsport inspirierte Chronographen-Armbanduhr in einem dunklen Studio. Im linken Vordergrund steht eine einzelne Edelstahl-Chronographenuhr leicht schräg im Dreiviertelprofil mit schwarzem Zifferblatt, zwei rot akzentuierten Hilfszifferblättern, schlanken silbernen Stundenmarkierungen, einer Tachymeter-Lünette sowie sichtbarer Krone und Drückern auf der rechten Seite. Die Uhr verfügt über ein schwarzes Lederarmband mit markanten roten Nähten an beiden Rändern und einem sportlichen Premium-Finish. Rechts neben der Uhr befindet sich eine leicht versetzte, schwarze quadratische Präsentationsbox in Lederoptik mit roten Ziernähten am Deckel und einem silbernen, geprägten augenförmigen Logo über dem Schriftzug „NESS STUDIO“ sowie dem kleineren roten Text „TRACK SURFACE“. Oben mittig im Bild ist dasselbe silberne Augen-Logo mit den Worten „NESS STUDIO“ und dem Zusatz „BY NICOLAS“ platziert. Im Hintergrund erstreckt sich das übergroße, unscharfe Wort {argument name="headline text" default="PRECISION"} in großen grauen Großbuchstaben über fast die gesamte Breite. Die Szene ist vor einem tiefschwarzen Hintergrund angesiedelt, durch den filmische rote und weiße horizontale Lichtstreifen von links nach rechts verlaufen, was Geschwindigkeit und Rennstrecken-Energie suggeriert. Verwenden Sie eine glänzende, nasse Bodenfläche mit reflektierender Textur, die rote Highlights und spiegelnde Reflexionen unter der Uhr und der Box einfängt. Unten mittig steht der Text „CHRONOGRAPH SERIES“ in klaren, weitläufigen weißen Großbuchstaben mit dünnen roten horizontalen Linien, die sich zu beiden Seiten erstrecken, und darunter in kleineren roten Großbuchstaben {argument name="tagline text" default="ALSACE MADE"}. Farbpalette: Schwarz, Anthrazit, silberner Stahl, leuchtendes Rennsport-Rot und ein Hauch von Weiß. Die Beleuchtung sollte kontrastreich und hochwertig sein, mit knackigen Glanzlichtern auf dem Metallgehäuse, subtiler Aufhellung der Box und stimmungsvollen Schatten. Gesamtstil: Hochglanz-Produktfotografie, Luxus-Uhrenkampagne, scharfer Fokus auf die Produkte, elegantes Branding, hochwertige Automobil-Ästhetik.
textTranslations.fr-FR: Une image publicitaire spectaculaire pour une montre-bracelet chronographe inspirée du sport automobile dans un studio sombre. Au premier plan, centre-gauche, présenter une montre chronographe en acier inoxydable posée verticalement avec un léger angle de trois-quarts, dotée d'un cadran noir, de deux sous-cadrans aux accents rouges, d'index argentés fins, d'une lunette tachymétrique, ainsi que de la couronne et des poussoirs visibles sur le côté droit. La montre possède un bracelet en cuir noir avec des surpiqûres rouges audacieuses sur les deux bords et une finition sportive haut de gamme. À droite de la montre, placer un coffret de présentation carré noir légèrement en retrait, à la texture cuir, avec des surpiqûres rouges autour du couvercle et un logo argenté en relief en forme d'œil au-dessus du texte « NESS STUDIO » et du texte rouge plus petit « TRACK SURFACE ». En haut au centre de la composition, ajouter le même logo en forme d'œil argenté avec les mots « NESS STUDIO » et, plus petit, « BY NICOLAS ». En arrière-plan, placer un mot surdimensionné et flou, {argument name="headline text" default="PRECISION"}, en grandes lettres capitales grises couvrant presque toute la largeur. La scène est installée sur un fond noir profond avec des traînées lumineuses horizontales rouges et blanches cinématiques traversant l'arrière des produits de gauche à droite, suggérant la vitesse et l'énergie des circuits. Utiliser un sol brillant et humide avec une texture réfléchissante, capturant des reflets rouges et des effets miroir sous la montre et le coffret. En bas au centre, ajouter le texte « CHRONOGRAPH SERIES » en capitales blanches espacées avec de fines lignes horizontales rouges s'étendant de chaque côté, et en dessous, en plus petites capitales rouges, le texte {argument name="tagline text" default="ALSACE MADE"}. Palette de couleurs : noir, gris anthracite, acier argenté, rouge course vif et une touche de blanc. L'éclairage doit être à fort contraste et haut de gamme, avec des reflets spéculaires nets sur le boîtier métallique, un remplissage doux et subtil sur le coffret et des ombres marquées. Style global : photographie de produit commerciale ultra-léchée, campagne de montre de luxe, mise au point nette sur les produits, image de marque élégante, esthétique automobile haut de gamme.
textTranslations.it-IT: Un'immagine pubblicitaria drammatica di un prodotto di lusso per un orologio cronografo ispirato al motorsport in uno studio scuro. In primo piano, a centro-sinistra, mostrare un singolo orologio cronografo in acciaio inossidabile posizionato verticalmente con una leggera angolazione di tre quarti, con quadrante nero, due quadranti secondari con accenti rossi, sottili indici delle ore argentati, una lunetta tachimetrica e corona e pulsanti visibili sul lato destro. L'orologio ha un cinturino in pelle nera con audaci cuciture rosse lungo entrambi i bordi e una finitura sportiva premium. A destra dell'orologio, posizionare una scatola di presentazione quadrata nera leggermente dietro di esso, con texture simile alla pelle, cuciture rosse attorno al coperchio e un logo argentato a forma di occhio in rilievo sopra il testo “NESS STUDIO” e il testo rosso più piccolo “TRACK SURFACE”. Al centro in alto della composizione, aggiungere lo stesso logo dell'occhio argentato con le parole “NESS STUDIO” e la scritta più piccola “BY NICOLAS”. Sullo sfondo, posizionare una parola sovradimensionata sfocata, {argument name="headline text" default="PRECISION"}, in grandi lettere maiuscole grigie che coprono quasi l'intera larghezza. La scena è ambientata su uno sfondo nero profondo con strisce di luce orizzontali cinematografiche rosse e bianche che attraversano dietro i prodotti da sinistra a destra, suggerendo velocità ed energia da pista. Utilizzare un piano d'appoggio lucido e bagnato con texture riflettente, che catturi riflessi rossi e specchiati sotto l'orologio e la scatola. Al centro in basso, aggiungere il testo “CHRONOGRAPH SERIES” in maiuscolo bianco pulito e spaziato con sottili linee orizzontali rosse che si estendono su entrambi i lati, e sotto di esso, in maiuscolo rosso più piccolo, la scritta {argument name="tagline text" default="ALSACE MADE"}. Tavolozza dei colori: nero, grigio antracite, acciaio argentato, rosso corsa vivido e un tocco di bianco. L'illuminazione deve essere ad alto contrasto e premium, con riflessi speculari nitidi sulla cassa in metallo, un leggero riempimento morbido sulla scatola e ombre suggestive. Stile generale: fotografia di prodotto commerciale ultra-rifinita, campagna di orologi di lusso, messa a fuoco nitida sui prodotti, branding elegante, estetica automobilistica di fascia alta.
textTranslations.pt-BR: Uma imagem publicitária dramática de produto de luxo para um relógio cronógrafo inspirado no automobilismo em um estúdio escuro. No primeiro plano, centro-esquerda, mostre um único relógio cronógrafo de aço inoxidável em pé, em um leve ângulo de três quartos, com mostrador preto, dois submostradores com detalhes em vermelho, marcadores de hora prateados finos, uma luneta taquimétrica e coroa e botões visíveis no lado direito. O relógio possui uma pulseira de couro preta com costura vermelha ousada ao longo de ambas as bordas e um acabamento esportivo premium. À direita do relógio, coloque uma caixa de apresentação quadrada preta levemente atrás dele, com textura de couro, costura vermelha ao redor da tampa e um logotipo prateado em relevo em formato de olho acima do texto “NESS STUDIO” e o texto menor em vermelho “TRACK SURFACE.” No topo central da composição, adicione o mesmo logotipo de olho prateado com as palavras “NESS STUDIO” e, abaixo, “BY NICOLAS” em letras menores. No fundo, coloque uma palavra grande e desfocada, {argument name="headline text" default="PRECISION"}, em letras maiúsculas cinzas grandes, abrangendo quase toda a largura.
